source_name: package, target, module and source-contribution graph
summary: Admit one closed deterministic package/module/source graph before any declaration or reference resolution.
requires: every package target exists and has one TargetId
every source contribution maps to exactly one ModuleId
the package dependency graph is acyclic
enumeration order is not identity or priority
preconditions: manifest, target and source rows are structurally valid
typed package, target, module and source identities are available
normalization: sort identity-bearing rows by their canonical typed keys and exclude paths, timestamps and traversal order from semantic identity
decision_procedure: resolve every declared target to one TargetId
resolve every module header and source contribution to one ModuleId
reject a missing or ambiguous package binding or a package cycle
reject a source/module mapping mismatch
otherwise emit one closed graph without order-dependent state
termination_metric: finite package, target, module and source tables
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 1: normalize graph -> resolve typed identities -> detect cycle/mapping mismatch -> diagnostic

summary: Merge all source contributions of one ModuleId into one conflict-free declaration skeleton set.
requires: all contributions belong to one admitted ModuleId
declaration and overload keys are canonical and deterministic
contribution enumeration order is not a winner
preconditions: every top-level declaration has one StableSymbolKey
normalization: sort contributions by ModuleId, StableSymbolKey and stable SourceOriginId before checking conflicts
decision_procedure: collect declaration skeletons from every source contribution
reject a duplicate non-overload declaration key
reject an overload-slot key collision
reject incompatible definitions contributed to one StableSymbolKey
otherwise return one order-independent skeleton set
termination_metric: finite source contributions and declaration skeletons
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 2: admitted graph -> collect skeletons -> normalize keys -> reject conflict

source_name: dependency, import, export and module-interface closure
summary: Close imports, exports, re-exports, signatures, facades and static dependencies against exact typed provider identities.
requires: each import and export resolves to one typed identity
re-export and static dependency graphs are acyclic
public residue does not expose a less-visible identity
facades do not invent or widen exports
preconditions: the package/module graph and item skeleton set are admitted
all binding names carry an explicit namespace
normalization: normalize each binding to consumer package, source-visible name, namespace and exact typed target; order does not affect identity
decision_procedure: resolve imports and exports to exact typed targets
validate aliases, visibility and normalized signature residue
reject re-export or static-dependency cycles
reject facade widening or invented exports
otherwise return closed interface bindings and dependency edges
termination_metric: finite binding tables and acyclic dependency graph traversal
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 3: graph/skeleton closure -> bind interfaces -> visibility/signature/facade checks -> cycle check

summary: Admit deterministic lexical name frames while keeping name, extension-activation and witness-visibility environments separate.
requires: each scope has one typed ResolverScopeId and at most one parent
same-frame namespace/name keys are unique
child shadowing allocates a fresh HirLocalId
failed pattern probes commit no binding
name, activation and evidence environments are not conflated
preconditions: every lexical frame has one stable parent relation
normalization: normalize namespace/name keys and typed origin identities; allocate committed local identities in deterministic semantic preorder
decision_procedure: open one separated name, activation and evidence frame for each resolver scope
reject same-frame duplicates and parameter/body-local or import/local collisions
reject illegal cross-frame overload merges and environment conflation
discard provisional bindings from failed pattern probes
on scope exit restore the parent frames without leaking child bindings
termination_metric: finite proper resolver-scope tree and finite bindings per frame
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 4: closed dependency bindings -> build separated frames -> admit bindings -> restore parent

summary: Collect the exact candidate set for one source reference in one namespace before visibility filtering or winner selection.
requires: the source reference has one explicit namespace role
qualified static paths use their exact owner path
candidate collection does not use return type or source traversal order
preconditions: the resolver scope tree is admitted
module and dependency bindings are closed
normalization: normalize the qualified owner path, namespace and typed candidate identity before set comparison
decision_procedure: select exactly the namespace named by the reference role
collect lexical, imported, module-static or owner-qualified candidates from the admitted frames
reject zero candidates, a wrong namespace or an unresolved static path
reject multiple candidates in the same resolver tier without using enumeration order
otherwise return the normalized candidate set for later visibility filtering
termination_metric: finite resolver ancestors and finite bindings per namespace
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 5: admitted scope tree -> exact namespace/path collection -> same-tier cardinality check

source_name: reference visibility, activation and evidence-origin filter
summary: Filter a collected candidate set by lexical visibility, extension activation, exact member visibility access proof, and witness evidence origin.
requires: visibility is checked against the declaring owner and consumer scope
a member access proof contains declaring_nominal_id, consumer_nominal_id, and consumer_relation
# admits only the declaring nominal and its nominal subclasses, never a module peer, nominal conformer that is not a subclass, or structural peer
extension activation remains separate from import
witness evidence is reused only from an admitted EvidenceOriginId
public residue cannot expose a less-visible identity
preconditions: ReferenceCandidateSetResolved produced a normalized candidate set
name, activation and evidence environments remain separate
normalization: normalize visibility domains, preserve the exact member sigil or OMITTED/null state, and normalize declaring_nominal_id, consumer_nominal_id, consumer_relation, and typed activation/evidence origins without creating a new witness
decision_procedure: filter candidates outside the lexical or member visibility domain
for an explicit # candidate require declaring_nominal_id, consumer_nominal_id, and consumer_relation in the access proof
admit # only when consumer_relation is DECLARING_NOMINAL with identical nominal identities or NOMINAL_SUBCLASS with a nominal subclass proof
reject # for MODULE_PEER, NOMINAL_CONFORMER_NOT_SUBCLASS, STRUCTURAL_PEER, unrelated, missing, or contradictory access proofs with reason MEMBER_VISIBILITY_DOMAIN
filter extension candidates not active in the current resolver scope
reject activation identity mismatch or scope escape
reject public API leakage and invalid evidence origin
otherwise return the visible activated set without materializing witness evidence
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 6: candidate set -> lexical/member visibility -> activation -> evidence origin -> API closure

summary: Select one deterministic noncall reference while leaving callable overload sets to the next cluster.
requires: only noncall reference namespaces are eligible for winner selection
a callable overload set remains ResolvedOverloadSetRef in analysis HIR
generic substitution, applicability and specificity are owned by the next cluster
source enumeration order is not a tie-breaker
preconditions: ReferenceVisibilityActivationAdmitted produced a visible candidate set
the source reference namespace has been classified as call or noncall
normalization: partition callable-overload candidates from noncall reference candidates before selection
decision_procedure: if the reference is callable, return ResolvedOverloadSetRef to analysis HIR without selecting a winner
for a noncall reference, filter to the exact namespace and lowest reachable lookup tier
reject zero or multiple candidates after filtering
reject any outcome that requires an order tie-breaker
otherwise commit one existing typed ResolvedRef
termination_metric: finite visible candidate set and finite lookup tiers
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 7: classify call domain -> bypass overload set or filter noncall namespace/tier -> exact cardinality

summary: Admit canonical HIR-H1 only when every noncall reference is fully resolved and no runtime relookup residue remains.
requires: unresolved_count is zero
noncall candidate_set_count is zero
each resolved reference carries an existing typed identity and visibility proof
runtime relookup residue count is zero
callable overload sets remain outside canonical HIR-H1 until the next cluster selects a winner
preconditions: all R4 graph, scope, candidate, visibility and noncall selection stages succeeded
analysis-HIR callable overload sets are fenced from canonical HIR-H1
normalization: sort resolver trace rows by stable SourceOriginId and preserve existing typed identity domains
decision_procedure: reject any unbound primary diagnostic state
reject nonzero unresolved or noncall candidate-set counts
reject missing typed identity or visibility proof
reject runtime relookup residue
otherwise seal the R4-resolved portion of canonical HIR-H1
termination_metric: finite resolver trace and HIR reference tables
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 8: completed resolver stages -> count/proof/relookup guards -> canonical HIR-H1 seal

source_name: module interface and dependency-receipt digest verification
summary: Verify that each dependency receipt binds the exact normalized provider module interface without treating private implementation bytes as interface identity.
requires: the interface digest covers normalized exported identity and signature residue
private provider body bytes do not affect the interface digest
each dependency receipt names the exact provider ModuleId and interface digest
required export edges are complete
preconditions: the resolver-HIR seal is complete for the R4-owned domain
normalization: canonicalize exported identities, visibility and signature residue before hashing; exclude private body bytes and traversal order
decision_procedure: recompute the normalized provider ModuleInterfaceDigest
verify every required export edge is present
compare the dependency receipt against the exact provider ModuleId and interface digest
reject stale, incomplete or mismatching receipts
otherwise return the verified interface identity
termination_metric: finite normalized export and dependency-receipt tables
evaluation_order: R4 ordinal 9: closed interfaces and sealed resolver output -> normalize interface -> verify edges and receipt digest
